description: Kühle Räume (Hitzeschutz) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gdi.berlin.de. The dataset shows the cool rooms currently available in the state of Berlin. Cool rooms have the goal of providing a retreat from heat in the summer and creating a way to rest and cool off on the go. They are part of the heat protection measures in the state of Berlin. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Cool rooms (heat protection)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, Karten, cool spaces, Bezirke, infoFeatureAccessService, Kühle Räume. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2026-07-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
